questions.q: Aunt Tee seeks help from Ar. Two for a single-storey, 2-bedroom residence. The first phase is the site selection analysis, which falls under pre-design services. Given that the scope of work for the site selection is well-defined, it is necessary to determine the most appropriate method of compensation for these services. What would be the most appropriate method of compensation for the site selection analysis under pre-design services?
o: Per Diem, Honorarium plus Reimbursable Expenses
questions.n: This is the recommended method for pre-design services involving site selection and analysis when the time commitment is measurable.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired by Aunt Tingan-ting to provide architectural design and engineering services for her 2-storey, 4-bedroom residence with a roof deck floor in a private subdivision. What would be the most appropriate type of contract for this project?
questions.n: Detailed Architectural and Engineering Design Services (DAEDS) covers both architectural and all allied engineering services under one contract.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired by Aunt Tingan-ting to provide architectural design and engineering services for her 2-storey, 4-bedroom residence with a roof deck floor in a private subdivision. What would be the appropriate percentage of the fee for an acceptance fee to initiate mobilization for the services that Ar. Bogart offers?
questions.n: The standard acceptance fee or mobilization fee to initiate architectural services is 5% of the total fee.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired by Aunt Tingan-ting to provide architectural design and engineering services for her 2-storey, 4-bedroom residence with a roof deck floor in a private subdivision. What would be the basis of the fee for an acceptance fee to initiate mobilization for the services that Ar. Bogart offers?
o: Statement of Probable project construction cost
questions.n: Since the final cost is unknown at the start, the SPPCC serves as the initial basis for fee calculations.

questions.q: Ar. Bogart was hired by Aunt Tingan-ting to provide architectural design and engineering services for her 2-storey, 4-bedroom residence with a roof deck floor in a private subdivision. If the Final Project Construction Cost exceeds the Statement of Probable Project Construction Cost, will Ar. Bogart receive the difference in his acceptance fee since it is based on the Statement of Probable Project Construction Cost?
o: Only if stipulated in a rider
questions.n: Professional fees are adjusted once the Final Project Construction Cost is determined.
